text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock C and Stock B at gains felt rewarding, but I should base each sale on my investment outlook and portfolio risk—not just the pleasure of locking in a profit.","My account value moved both up and down across these periods, so I should keep diversification and risk in view rather than react to short-term changes.","Several periods passed without trades; I should be comfortable holding when that best fits my plan, instead of trading simply because I check my account often."]}
